Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoconference

Class JitsiUrlBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoconference.JitsiUrlBuilder
public final class JitsiUrlBuilder extends Object
Builds Jitsi Meet room URLs from a ConferenceRoom plus the application VideoConferenceSettings.

This is the one piece of real "conferencing protocol" in the client and it is deliberately pure and side-effect free (no AWT, no I/O, no network) so it is exhaustively unit-testable. The audio/video session itself is carried by the launched Jitsi Meet client (WebRTC in a browser or an external softphone); this class only produces the correct, correctly-encoded deep link that puts the user in the right room with the right identity and mute state.

Jitsi reads configuration from the URL fragment: https://<domain>/<room>#config.<key>=<value>&userInfo.<key>.%22<value>%22. Boolean config values are lower-case; user-info values are percent-encoded and wrapped in percent-encoded double quotes.

  • Method Details

    • sanitizeRoom

      public static String sanitizeRoom(String raw)
      Reduces a free-text room name to a Jitsi-safe, URL-safe token: keeps [A-Za-z0-9._-] and drops everything else (spaces, punctuation, accents, emoji). The result is what actually appears in the URL path.
      Parameters:
      raw - the room name as typed by the user
      Returns:
      the sanitized token, or an empty string if nothing usable remains

    • normalizeDomain

      public static String normalizeDomain(String domain)
      Normalizes a domain: trims whitespace, strips a leading scheme (http:// / https://) and any trailing slash or path.
      Parameters:
      domain - the raw domain text
      Returns:
      a bare host suitable for a URL authority, or empty when blank

    • resolveDomain

      public static String resolveDomain(ConferenceRoom room, VideoConferenceSettings settings)
      Resolves the domain a room joins on: the room's own domain when set, otherwise the application default.
      Parameters:
      room - the room
      settings - the application settings
      Returns:
      the effective normalized domain (never blank)

    • generateRoomName

      public static String generateRoomName()
      Generates a friendly, hard-to-guess room name for an ad-hoc meeting, e.g. AmberFalcon-4821. Collisions are astronomically unlikely and the name is easy to read aloud when inviting someone by phone.
      Returns:
      a new random room name

    • buildShareUrl

      public static String buildShareUrl(ConferenceRoom room, VideoConferenceSettings settings)
      Builds the clean, shareable room link with no personal configuration: https://<domain>/<room>. This is the URL to copy and send to invitees so they join without inheriting this user's identity or mute state.
      Parameters:
      room - the room
      settings - the application settings (for the default domain)
      Returns:
      the bare room URL, or null when the room name is empty

    • buildExternalCommand

      public static String buildExternalCommand(String template, String url)
      Substitutes VideoConferenceSettings.URL_TOKEN in the external command template with the meeting URL. When the template has no token the URL is appended as a trailing argument.
      Parameters:
      template - the external command template
      url - the meeting URL
      Returns:
      the concrete command string, or empty when the template is blank

    • percentEncode

      public static String percentEncode(String value)
      Percent-encodes a string for use in a URL fragment: every byte outside the RFC 3986 unreserved set (A-Za-z0-9-._~) becomes %XX of its UTF-8 encoding. Space becomes %20 (not +).
      Parameters:
      value - the text to encode
      Returns:
      the percent-encoded form
